summary: Cold-offline boot smoke verified: the sandbox-network blocker recorded at 2026-09-26T22:40:00Z (Docker could reach registries but not PyPI/npm) had cleared by 2026-09-26T22:5x — confirmed live (pypi.org and registry.npmjs.org both returned 200, a plain python:3.12-slim container could pip-install uv). Rebuilt and booted the full stack with `docker compose up -d --build`; all six services (app, worker, db, cache, objectstore, caddy) reached healthy. Fixed one real defect found along the way: INSTALLED_APPS was missing django.contrib.staticfiles, which the entrypoint's `manage.py collectstatic` step needs. Added docker-compose.offline-smoke.yml (marks the compose network internal:true) and scripts/cold-offline-smoke (make cold-boot-smoke): reuses the already-built images with the network's egress cut, confirming the *running* stack — not just the build — needs no hosted dependency, per the challenge's one-command/network-off rule. Host-published-port access under internal:true didn't route in this sandbox's Docker networking (an environment quirk, not a product defect), so the script asserts end-to-end health via `docker compose exec caddy curl` inside the internal network instead; host port 8080 was separately confirmed reachable on the normal (non-internal) network before and after.
